purpose: Defines the testing norms, requirement-to-design-to-verification mapping, cross-cutting scenarios and approval status used to verify the doc-link design.
summary: State-machine transition tables are the sole source of allowed transitions; guard failures and unlisted events must be rejected
Absent reference targets do not block candidate confirmation; interruption, rerun and multi-key isolation are tested
check-impact tests cover read-only behavior, hash comparison, repeated notification, and no cascading or endless notification
check-links tests cover inline links with DLID titles and recorded-hash word shape
Deterministic processing gets separate unit tests such as parsing, ID handling, path resolution, hashes and output validation
A table maps requirements to primary designs and main verification points including acceptance criteria
Seven cross-cutting scenarios: first build, move, content change, failure, multiple keys, out-of-scope reference, later reference
Approval status states all open requirement items are decided and the design has been reviewed and approved
tasks: Writing or reviewing tests for doc-link
Checking requirement coverage of the design
Verifying state transitions against the transition tables
title: DES-009 要件対応と設計検証
